frozen_choices.primary_moneyline_model: xgb_two_head (coherent XGBoost score-distribution model), calibrated with temperature scaling -- best calibrated coherent model per outputs/rebuild/mlb_calibrated_ensemble_comparison.json
frozen_choices.independent_moneyline_challenger: xgb_direct (direct XGBoost binary classifier) -- may disagree with the coherent model (model_family_disagreement) but must never generate spread/total
frozen_choices.score_distribution_family: negative_binomial -- best OOF log loss per outputs/rebuild/mlb_distribution_comparison.json
frozen_choices.calibration_method: temperature scaling, selected independently per model via 4-method (identity/Platt/temperature/isotonic) chronological cross-fit comparison, outputs/rebuild/mlb_calibration_comparison.json; calibrator artifacts config/models/challengers/mlb-{two_head,xgb_two_head,xgb_direct}-calibrator-v1.json
frozen_choices.ensemble_decision: no ensemble -- meta-cross-fit comparison (outputs/rebuild/mlb_calibrated_ensemble_comparison.json) found every ensemble method scores worse than or indistinguishable from the single best calibrated model alone; the single calibrated xgb_two_head model is used directly, not a constructed ensemble
frozen_choices.feature_schema: MLB_INTENSITY_FEATURES / MLB_DIFFERENTIAL_FEATURES / XGB_DIRECT_FEATURES as defined in src/model_prediction/rebuild/mlb_features.py at commit 0ede6e6
